title: India on the rise as a study destination for local students
summary_en: As the ‘big four’ study destinations continue to lose market share, new data reveals a surge in Indian students opting for in-country postgraduate education.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: India on the rise as a study destination for local students

title: Scottish minister urges UK government to “get behind” international higher education
summary_en: International collaboration has “never been more important” and the UK must “stand up for the benefits of higher education as a true UK asset”, Scotland’s tertiary education minister told the BUILA conference in Glasgow.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Scottish minister urges UK government to “get behind” international higher education

title: England to push on with international student levy despite sector’s concerns
summary_en: The UK government is pressing ahead with plans to introduce a levy on the international student fee income of English universities despite concerns raised by the sector.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: England to push on with international student levy despite sector’s concerns

title: Australian regulators raise compliance concerns over agent commission ban
summary_en: Australia’s higher education and vocational education regulators have issued a joint sector alert warning providers over practices that may undermine a ban on education agent commissions linked to onshore overseas student transfers.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Australian regulators raise compliance concerns over agent commission ban

title: Made Impact aims to “change the narrative” with UN summit
summary_en: The inaugural Made Impact Summit 2026 will take place at the United Nations in New York, it has been confirmed.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert
title_cn: Made Impact aims to “change the narrative” with UN summit
